{{Quote|The goal of the Messengers is to help those with Force sensitivity who are left without guidance.|Amity|translated=1|<ref name="Tidings">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Cold Moon's Tidings|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>}}
The '''Messengers of the Cold Moon''' were an organization active during the [[Third Galactic War]] dedicated to helping [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals who could not, or would not, join the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. They welcomed those who were not powerful enough to be recruited, or too old to become Jedi, and taught them. They were not dedicated to either the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] or [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], rather letting members find their own path in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. For example, [[Amity (individual)|Amity]] was a light-sided Force-sensitive too old to join the Jedi, so he joined the Messengers.<ref name="Tidings" />

After the early phase of their training, students of the Messengers would go on a pilgrimage to "find their place in the Force," after which the Elders would evaluate what the student learned and give them a place in the organization.<ref name="Tidings" />
